WELCOME TO VOLUME 18, ISSUE 4
OF NIH MEDLINEPLUS MAGAZINE.
semantic_text: WELCOME TO VOLUME 18, ISSUE 4 OF NIH MEDLINEPLUS MAGAZINE.

plain_text:
We're closing out 2023 with articles about
attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD),
anxiety and antidepressants, and a groundbreaking
breast cancer study.
semantic_text: We're closing out 2023 with articles about attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), anxiety and antidepressants, and a groundbreaking breast cancer study.

plain_text:
This issue's cover star Penn Holderness
shares his experience being diagnosed with
ADHD as an adult. The YouTube content creator
and winner of The Amazing Race credits much of
his success to his condition and calls for greater
understanding of ADHD as a lifelong journey.
We also take a deeper dive into ADHD's signs
and treatments and clear up some common
questions about it.

National Institute of Environmental Health
